exposure: Conventional magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) features (low signal intensity bands on T2WI)
Intravoxel incoherent motion (IVIM) parameters (f value, D value)
outcome: Transfused units of red blood cells (RBCs)
cohort: The participants are 56 patients with placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) disorders who had normal singleton pregnancies at 33-39 weeks of gestation.
finding: Previous cesarean sections, low signal intensity bands on T2WI, and the D value were independent risk factors for adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes, while the f value was positively correlated with postpartum hemorrhage and units of red blood cells transfused.
mod_finding: Previous cesarean sections were identified as an independent risk factor for adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes.
cross-section timing: MRI examination performed at 33-39 weeks of gestation.
